package.name: rfl_msgs
package.description: ROS 2 interface definitions for the Robot Foundation Layer Driver Interface (spec/03 § Canonical driver messages). The four canonical payloads — execute / telemetry / status / clearance — mapped to a ROS 2 action, topic, and service (see the design at docs/design/2026-06-01-ros2-transport-binding-design.md and the classification in rfl-conformance::ros2). Protocol-level fields are typed per the spec/03 tables; representation-owned sub-payloads (owned by spec/02 and spec/04 and deliberately floored by the driver-interface schema) ride as canonical JSON strings rather than being re-encoded here.
